text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Some Umamusume shine brightly without
ever
facing any obstacles.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And that's wonderful for them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But those who can rise to their feet,
even after getting struck down by
sudden illness and being
burdened with
pain...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wheeze! Huff... Pant, pant... I... did it...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I... beat Taiki! And in a mile... no less!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They emit an entirely different light—a
light that
can only come from a genuine
pearl.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Great job... Pearl... That was some...
fantastic
runnin'...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I jus' couldn't keep up with you... You,
um... all
right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Wheeze... Of course, I'm not all right. I beat you...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Both my body and mind... are
completely
shattered...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I'm perfectly fine. Why would
you think
otherwise?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh? What jus' happened?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Shhh! Not a peep!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(I can't... let you see me acting all weak
like that.)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(Right, I'm a shining pearl! So I have to
be the
most beautiful existence around!)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
More importantly... Trainer, what did
you think?
How'd you like this new and
improved me?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Do you think I can take on the world
now? Is my
potential enough to clash
with international
titans?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. I guess I passed the test with
flying hues! Mishaps and health
conditions? Who cares?
Nothing can
stop me!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Even if the road ahead is blocked, there
are
always plenty other paths I can take.
My
potential... is infinite!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Suzuka... Pearl was so buono today. ♪

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
She was. I think her lack of hesitation
was what
allowed her to run so well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka and Hishi Akebono, who
both ran
alongside her today, seem to
have noticed
something about her too.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: By the way, Taiki. Next year...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm going abroad so I can show everyone
that
there's nothing I can't do!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: That sure is amazin'! In that case...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I reckon I'm gonna have to go abroad
too. ♪ I
can't jus' sit back and let you
get all the glory!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Huh? W-wait, what? Taiki, what are you
talking
about?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Did I say somethin' wrong?
choice_data_list: Taiki Shuttle, that's a bit much...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: The more, the merrier, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I wanna run 'round the world with ya,
Pearl!
C'mon, lemme join ya! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What was supposed to be an offhand
comment
has suddenly earned Seeking
the Pearl a rather
unexpected rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now, Taiki Shuttle has her sights set
abroad too. It appears becoming the
first Tracen Uma to win a European G1
title is going to be an even fiercer
battle than we anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I really shouldn't have let that slip...
Taiki's decision to go abroad was like a
bolt from the azure. Well, not like we
can do anything about it
now.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We don't have any time to be sitting
around,
Trainer! Let's get to making next
year's plans!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd like her run a few more races before
we go abroad. In her new and improved
form, Seeking
the Pearl has the greatest
aptitude for sprints.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to see how well she can do in a

1,200-meter race. It has to be a G1, of
course,
which leaves us with...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The Takamatsunomiya Kinen... So you
want me to
do a 1,200-meter lightning
round after my mile
race, huh?
choice_data_list: Why don't we go for the Takamatsun...
Why don't we go for the Takamatsun...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Let's do that! I'll show everyone
my
untouchable speed before we head
out of the
country!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After overcoming a great challenge,
Seeking the Pearl heads into her senior
year with her sights set
on an expedition
abroad.
